subject: EdgeGrid integration: on‑prem/VPC technical deep‑dive and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@edgegrid.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: EdgeGrid integration: on‑prem/VPC technical deep‑dive and next steps

Hi Jordan & Priya,

Thanks again for taking the discovery call this morning — really useful to hear about EdgeGrid's latency and data residency requirements for your telemetry ingestion pipeline. Quick recap + suggested next steps so we stay aligned: 

- What we heard: primary constraint is keeping PII and raw telemetry in your VPC/on‑prem; you need a Private deployment (VPC peering or on‑prem appliance) with KMS integration and audit logs. Peak inference load ~400 QPS (avg 220), typical sequence lengths ~512 tokens.
- Key technical asks from your team: network egress limits, cert/PKI process, and support for two‑way TLS.

Next step: schedule a 60‑minute technical deep‑dive (architecture review) with your infra/security engineers + our Private deployment team so we can align on network diagrams, firewall requirements, and rollout plan. Proposed windows (PDT):
  * Tue Jul 13 — 10:00–11:00 or 14:00–15:00
  * Wed Jul 14 — 09:00–10:00

If none of these work, feel free to pick a slot on my booking page: https://calendly.com/redwood-td/60min?ref=eg-integration

What we'll bring to the call: draft network diagram, SSO/KMS checklist, and our on‑prem connectivity options (VPC Peering, Private Control Plane, or air‑gapped appliance). Please invite whoever will own certs/network/firewall rules and, if possible, attach any existing network diagrams.

I attached a short agenda and a stub network requirements doc to help prepare. 

Cheers,

Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0183

Attachments: proposed-agenda-td.pdf (agenda), EdgeGrid_Network_Requirements_v1.pdf (network Qs checklist)

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. Tue Jul 13 10:00–11:00 PDT works for us. I'll add the following folks to the invite: Aman Kapoor (Network Lead), Sofia Ruiz (Security), and Priya (product).

Two quick notes so your team can prepare:
- We have an existing site‑to‑site VPN into AWS (Transit Gateway) and can open dedicated routes for the appliance if needed.
- Our PKI is managed by HashiCorp Vault; if you have a KMS integration guide, please surface it in the call.

Looking forward — I've accepted the proposed slot and attached a short PDF with our current network topology (redacted).

Best,
Jordan

jordan.lee@edgegrid.com | +1 206‑555‑0220
